ability.name: Step 6 - Service Fingerprinting
ability.description: Performs native unauthenticated banner discovery on critical services.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $services_file = "$d\services.json"; if (-not (Test-Path $services_file)) { throw "services.json not found" }; $services = Get-Content $services_file -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($ip in $services.PSObject.Properties.Name) { $ports = $services.$ip | ForEach-Object { $_.port }; if ($ports -contains 389 -or $ports -contains 636) { Write-Output "Fingerprinting LDAP on $ip..."; try { $de = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://$ip"); $de.RefreshCache(); $dnsHostName = $de.Properties['dnsHostName'].Value; $defaultNamingContext = $de.Properties['defaultNamingContext'].Value; $domainFunctionality = $de.Properties['domainFunctionality'].Value; Write-Output "IP: $ip | LDAP_DNS: $dnsHostName | BASE_DN: $defaultNamingContext | FUNC_LEVEL: $domainFunctionality"; $dnsHostName | Out-File "$d\dns_hostname_$ip.txt" -Encoding ascii; $defaultNamingContext | Out-File "$d\base_dn_$ip.txt" -Encoding ascii } catch { Write-Output "IP: $ip | LDAP unauthenticated check failed - $($_.Exception.Message)" } }; if ($ports -contains 445) { Write-Output "Fingerprinting SMB on $ip..."; try { net view \\$ip /all 2>&1 | Out-File "$d\smb_shares_$ip.txt" -Encoding ascii; Write-Output "IP: $ip | SMB fingerprint successful" } catch { Write-Output "IP: $ip | SMB check failed - $($_.Exception.Message)" } } } } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step6 failed - $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step6.txt

rationale: Performs deep banner grabbing and unauthenticated AD schema queries natively.
